Description: Enforces security baseline for faculty and staff devices including BitLocker encryption, Microsoft Defender, firewall protection, password requirements, and OS compliance. Integrated with Conditional Access to restrict access for non-compliant devices.

iOS and iPadOS Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) compliance policy implementing baseline mobile security, encryption, password enforcement, jailbreak protection, and secure institutional access controls through Microsoft Intune.

Applies a balanced compliance baseline for student and faculty devices, enforcing essential security controls such as password protection, antivirus, firewall, and basic OS compliance while maintaining usability for BYOD scenarios.
